title: JSFL: getSelectedFrames/setSelectedFrames, doc.layers, importFile, getDataFromDocument stubs
description:
Add 4 missing JSFL stubs to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. timeline.getSelectedFrames(): number[] - returns currently selected frame indices. Add to JsflTimeline interface. Implementation can return [state.doc.currentFrameIndex ?? 0] as a stub (no full selection tracking needed).
2. timeline.setSelectedFrames(startFrame: number, endFrame: number, replaceCurrentSelection?: boolean): void - stub that warns and is a no-op. Add to JsflTimeline interface.
3. doc.layers: readonly JsflLayer[] - shortcut getter on JsflDocument that returns getTimeline().layers. Add to JsflDocument interface and makeDocumentProxy.
4. doc.importFile(fileURL: string, importToLibrary?: boolean): void - browser stub that warns: 'doc.importFile: not supported in browser context'. Add to JsflDocument interface and makeDocumentProxy.
5. doc.getDataFromDocument(name: string): any - returns undefined, add console.warn stub
6. doc.addDataToDocument(name: string, type: string, data: any): void - no-op stub with console.warn

Items 5 and 6 are very small stubs.
